rubrics_metrics.name: Key dates / Entry timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Important dates for entry and awards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First Entry Deadline: 5 December 2025; Final Entry Deadline: 12 December 2025; Shortlist Announcement: 19 February 2026; Awards Ceremony: 25 March 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging by an industry jury
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects and people are judged by a panel of jurors drawn from senior communications professionals and industry leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists a large panel of named jurors (heads of communications, agency founders, directors and senior industry figures) and links to view the full list of jurors; implies peer industry judging and sector expertise will inform winners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event logistics for entrants/winners
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards Ceremony and related event details
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards Ceremony: 25 March 2026 at Crown Sydney; Pre-Ceremony Drinks and timings provided. (Practical guidance for attendees rather than judging criteria.)
